error_direction_rationale: The check is exact integer equality over the pasted values: the conservation delta is reported exactly, in signed zatoshi, and negative pools are named individually, so the arithmetic neither over-reports nor under-reports anything. The residual risk is not approximation but authenticity: whether the pasted numbers are true of any chain is unknowable to this kernel and is declared as unrepresented_known, not smoothed over by an error direction.
